## Change

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Link an issue if applicable.

## Evidence

- Commands and results:
- UI changes: screenshots using synthetic data; controls/headset tested:

## Review

- [ ] No credentials, private addresses, conversations or runtime data included.
- [ ] Relevant tests pass; physical hardware claims distinguish measured from untested.
- [ ] No implicit model turns, approval acceptance or permission expansion.
- [ ] Dependency changes include regenerated locks and update acceptance evidence.
